children: Huntington will present at the 2026 Barclays Global Financial Services Conference and furnished presentation slides highlighting $284B in assets and progress on partner synergies.
Management presentation (Steve Steinour, CEO; Zach Wasserman, CFO) made slides available as Exhibit 99.1 to investors.
Slides state Huntington has $284B assets, $189B loans and $222B deposits (balances as of 6/30/26).
Partner synergies: $365M Cadence run-rate by 4Q26 and $70M Veritex run-rate by 2Q26; revenue synergies tracking above prior forecasts.
FY26 outlook: ~36% loan growth, ~33% deposit growth, ~32% noninterest income growth; expense synergies of $435M run-rate by 4Q26.
Revised FY27 targets noted: EPS range $1.75–$1.83, increased planned share repurchases of $1.3–1.4B and recalibrated loan/NIM expectations given market dynamics.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
